name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.305.0 — port-check, spec-number-check, workspace-scan, design-contract-check and catalog-inventory now write stdout through the shared lib/sync-write.js: EAGAIN retries and a closed reader (EPIPE) no longer crash them. 7.304.0 — A review-driver legs re-run (--mark skips-extracted, --mark repair-round) over an unchanged tree copies the prior iteration's green rows for the expensive legs and spawns only the red or input-dependent ones; a changed tree re-runs everything, and a leg that went red then green over the same tree is named flaky in the driver output and sidecar. 7.303.0 — Review ledger repairs: evidence promotion keys build rows by runId, so a build row restamped at close replaces the merged pre-restamp copy instead of landing as a second row with the same runId; the fix cap and the review row's iteration count fix rounds (distinct fix-delta sources), so a skips re-run inside a fix round no longer spends a second round.
